topics.title: Nature of services and their difference from goods

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the five Is of services: intangibility, inconsistency, inseparability, inventory (less) and involvement.
Distinguish services from goods on the basis of nature, type and the five Is.

topics.title: Types of services and business services

concepts.learning_objective: Classify services into business, social and personal services with examples.
Identify the specialised business services that enterprises depend on and explain why.

topics.title: Banking: types of banks and functions of commercial banks

concepts.learning_objective: Describe commercial, cooperative, specialised and central banks.
Explain the functions of commercial banks, including deposits, lending, cheques, remittance and allied services.
Explain the concept of e-banking and the range of services it offers.
Explain the benefits of e-banking to customers and to banks.
Explain the fundamental principle and functions of insurance.
Apply the principles of insurance such as utmost good faith, indemnity, contribution and mitigation.

topics.title: Types of insurance: life, fire and marine

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the types of life insurance policies and the needs each one meets.
Explain the elements of fire and marine insurance and compare them with life insurance.
Describe the financial, mail and allied facilities offered by postal services.
Describe the types of telecom services available to business.
Explain the importance of transportation as a business service.
Describe private, public, bonded, government and cooperative warehouses.
Explain the functions of warehousing such as consolidation, break the bulk, stock piling and financing.
